days.title: Historic City Center Discovery
days.description: Explore the iconic downtown core of Ningbo with three major cultural landmarks within walking distance.

attractions.place: Drum Tower (鼓楼), Ningbo
Tianyi Pavilion (天一阁), Ningbo
Ningbo Museum (宁波博物馆), Ningbo

days.title: Old Town & Waterfront Exploration
days.description: Walk through traditional architecture and historic ruins, ending at the peaceful Yuyuan Garden by the lake.

attractions.place: Ningbo Old Street (宁波老街), Ningbo
Ningbo City Wall Ruins (宁波城墙遗址), Ningbo
Yuyuan Garden (月湖公园), Ningbo

days.title: Central Cultural Institutions
days.description: Discover Ningbo's philosophical heritage and modern cultural scene through temple, plaza, and ceramic art.

attractions.place: Ningbo Confucian Temple (宁波孔庙), Ningbo
Ningbo Tianyi Square (天一广场), Ningbo
Ningbo Ceramic Art Museum (宁波陶瓷艺术博物馆), Ningbo

days.title: Southern Lake District Loop
days.description: Journey through Ningbo's southern region featuring the largest lake, mountain hiking, and aquatic attractions.

attractions.place: Dongqian Lake (东钱湖), Ningbo
Qingcheng Mountain (青城山), Ningbo
Ningbo Aquarium (宁波海洋世界), Ningbo

days.title: Eastern Port & Waterfront
days.description: Explore Ningbo's maritime heritage and modern port district along the scenic bund.

attractions.place: Ningbo Port Museum (宁波港口博物馆), Ningbo
Ningbo Bund (宁波滩涂), Ningbo

days.title: Botanical Garden Immersion
days.description: Spend a leisurely day exploring Ningbo's extensive botanical gardens in the southern district.

attractions.place: Ningbo Botanical Garden (宁波植物园), Ningbo

days.title: Yinzhou District Museums & Parks
days.description: Discover recreational parks, interactive children's exhibits, and contemporary art in the Yinzhou District.

attractions.place: Ningbo Yinzhou District Park (鄞州公园), Ningbo
Ningbo Children's Museum (宁波儿童博物馆), Ningbo
Ningbo Art Museum (宁波美术馆), Ningbo

days.title: Silk Heritage & Modern Shopping
days.description: Return to downtown to explore Ningbo's silk traditions and enjoy modern shopping at Wanda Plaza.

attractions.place: Ningbo Silk Museum (宁波丝绸博物馆), Ningbo
Ningbo Wanda Plaza (万达广场), Ningbo

days.title: Southwest Fenghua District Excursion
days.description: Journey to the southwestern Fenghua District to explore ancient town architecture and mountain scenic areas.

attractions.place: Ningbo Fenghua Ancient Town (奉化古镇), Fenghua
Xuedou Mountain (雪窦山), Fenghua

days.title: Northern Cixi District Discovery
days.description: Travel north to explore Cixi's ancient town and historic Longshan Temple.

attractions.place: Ningbo Cixi Ancient Town (慈溪古镇), Cixi
Longshan Temple (龙山寺), Cixi

days.title: Western Hemudu Archaeological Heritage
days.description: Explore the ancient Hemudu civilization at the westernmost point of the Ningbo itinerary.

attractions.place: Hemudu Culture Park (河姆渡遗址公园), Ningbo

days.title: Southern Ninghai Coastal Journey
days.description: Venture to southern Ninghai County to experience scenic mountains and traditional fishing village heritage.

attractions.place: Ninghai County Scenic Area (宁海县风景区), Ninghai
Shipu Ancient Fishing Village (石浦古渔村), Ninghai

days.title: Qiandao Lake Scenic Adventure
days.description: Explore the famous thousand-island lake in the southwestern region with boat tours and island exploration.

attractions.place: Ningbo Qiandao Lake (千岛湖), Ningbo

days.title: Tiantong Temple & Eastern Scenic Region
days.description: Return to eastern elevated regions to visit the historic Tiantong Temple and explore scenic mountain areas.

attractions.place: Tiantong Temple (天童寺), Ningbo

days.title: Final Downtown Reflection & Departure
days.description: Return to central Ningbo for final shopping, dining, and reflection on the 15-day journey before departure.

attractions.place: Ningbo City Center (宁波市中心), Ningbo
